name: skilltap
description: Official skills for using skilltap — install, discover, and author agent skills, plugins, and standalone MCP servers.

skills.name: skilltap
skills.description: Install, update, remove, list, toggle, adopt, move, configure, and inspect agent skills, plugins, and standalone MCP servers via the skilltap CLI. Covers state.json, skilltap.toml + skilltap.lock (project manifest + lockfile), config.toml (flat [security] + [scanner] blocks), filesystem layout, non-interactive use (TTY / plain / JSON output modes), and troubleshooting.

skills.name: skilltap-find
skills.description: Discover and search for agent skills, plugins, and standalone MCP servers via skilltap taps and the skills.sh registry. Covers source formats for typed installs (install skill / plugin / mcp), git-only tap management, and trust tiers.

skills.name: skilltap-author
skills.description: Create, scaffold, validate, and publish agent skills, plugins, and taps. Covers SKILL.md frontmatter, the native .skilltap/<name>.toml plugin format (plus Claude Code and Codex), tap.json indexes, provenance, and publishing workflows.
